plan_needed: Claude Free or any paid plan, plus an active Xero subscription. On Claude Team or Enterprise, an Owner must add the connector for the team first (see claude-team-owner-adds-xero).

steps.do: In Claude, go to Customize > Connectors. In the desktop app, Customize is in the sidebar.
steps.see: The Connectors page.

steps.do: Select Discover, type "Xero" in Search connectors, then select Xero.
steps.see: Xero's listing, made by Xero Limited, under Financial services.

steps.do: Select Connect to Claude. Anthropic's docs use that name, and the public listing showed Add to Claude on 18 November 2026, so select whichever you see.
steps.see: Xero's sign-in page. On claude.ai it opens in the same tab. In the desktop app it opens in your browser.

steps.do: Sign in with your usual Xero login.
steps.see: Xero asks which organisation to connect.

steps.do: Choose the organisation you want Claude to read. If you have more than one, select each one you want. Then select Allow.
steps.see: You're back in Claude, with Xero under Your connectors.

steps.do: In a new chat, select + in the message box, then Connectors, and switch Xero on.
steps.see: Xero's toggle is on for this conversation.

steps.do: Ask a first question. If Claude asks to use a Xero tool, select Allow once.
steps.see: An answer from live Xero data, with links back to the Xero report, invoice or contact it used.

plan_needed: Claude Team or Enterprise, Owner or Primary Owner role.

steps.do: Go to Organization settings > Connectors, click Browse connectors, select Xero and click Add to your team.
steps.see: Xero becomes available to the team. Nobody gets access automatically.

steps.do: From the directory, the button reads Connect for your team. To try it on your own first, select the arrow beside it, then Connect just for me.
Under Tool permissions, choose Always allow, Needs approval or Blocked for each group of tools or for a single tool. Anthropic says these settings apply to everyone in the organisation.
steps.see: Members can't override these settings.

steps.do: Tell each person to connect their own Xero login. Nobody gets access automatically.
steps.see: Each person sees only what their own Xero login allows.

plan_needed: Any paid Claude plan (Anthropic recommends Team for businesses with more than one person), the Claude Cowork desktop app, and the Xero connector connected.

steps.where: Claude marketplace, Small Business plugin listing
steps.do: Click Install in Cowork.
steps.see: The plugin installs in Claude Cowork.

steps.do: Connect the Xero connector if you haven't already (see claude-to-xero).
steps.see: Workflows that list Xero can read your Xero data.

steps.do: Run a workflow such as /monday-brief or /close-month.
steps.see: The workflow starts in approval mode. Claude drafts and stages the work, and nothing is sent, posted or paid until you approve it.

plan_needed: A ChatGPT account and a Xero subscription. Xero Central asks for ChatGPT Plus, or access to ChatGPT Work, Codex or ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets. OpenAI says availability depends on your plan, workspace, role and region, and some workspaces need admin approval. Xero's Australian release notes list the plugin, but no page names Australia outright.

steps.do: In ChatGPT on the web, desktop or mobile, open the Plugins tab and search for Xero.
steps.see: The Xero plugin by Xero Limited appears.

steps.do: Open the Xero plugin's details and select the plus button (OpenAI's help centre calls it Install plugin).
steps.see: The plugin installs and may start Xero's sign-in.

steps.do: When asked, sign in with your Xero login. Select every Xero organisation you want ChatGPT to read, then click Allow access.
steps.see: The Xero plugin is connected to the organisations you chose.

steps.do: Start a new chat. Type @ and pick Xero, or just ask and let ChatGPT choose.
steps.see: Read-only answers from live Xero data, with links back to Xero.

plan_needed: A paid Microsoft 365 Business or Enterprise account and a Xero subscription. Xero's Australian Copilot page asks for a paid Microsoft 365 Copilot licence. Xero Central says your Microsoft 365 administrator has to enable the Xero agent first.

steps.do: From your Microsoft 365 account, open Copilot chat.
steps.see: Copilot chat, with Agents in the left navigation menu.

steps.where: Copilot chat, Agents or the Agent Store
steps.do: Under Agents, find and open Xero. Or go to the Agent Store, find Xero and click Add or Open. If your admin hasn't enabled it, you'll see an option to request approval instead.
steps.see: A chat with the Xero agent, or an approval request option.

steps.do: Ask a question about your Xero data.
steps.see: Copilot asks you to sign in to Xero.

steps.do: Follow the prompts to sign in to Xero. Select every organisation you want Copilot to read, then click Allow access.
steps.see: Once connected, Copilot answers your question.

steps.do: Ask about profit, cash, receivables or overdue invoices. If you've connected more than one organisation, name the one you mean.
steps.see: Read-only answers from Xero, with links to open the report, invoice or customer record in Xero.

steps.do: Open the Integrated apps section and find the Xero agent.
steps.see: The agent's permissions and data access, plus its terms of use and privacy statement.

steps.do: Allow the agent for some or all users, or block it.
steps.see: Users can only use agents the admin allows and that they've installed or been assigned.

plan_needed: Any Xero business plan and a Google account with access to Gemini. Google lists the Xero app for personal Google accounts only, for people 18 or over, in English. Scheduled tasks in Gemini Spark also need a Google AI Pro or AI Ultra plan. No page names Australia outright.

steps.do: Go to gemini.google.com.
steps.see: Gemini opens.

steps.do: In the sidebar, click Customize (click More first if you don't see it), then click Connectors at the top. Xero Central calls this page Connected Apps.
steps.see: The apps available to your account and country.

steps.do: Find and open Xero, then click Connect. Google's general steps call this button Add, so select whichever you see.
steps.see: Xero asks you to sign in, if you aren't signed in already.

steps.do: Enter your Xero email and password if asked. Select every organisation you want to use with Gemini, then click Allow.
steps.see: Xero is connected to Gemini.

steps.do: In a chat, include @Xero or "Xero" in your question. If you've connected more than one organisation, name the one you mean.
steps.see: Answers from live Xero data. Xero Central says Gemini can't change anything in your Xero organisation.

from: Xero MCP server (in an AI app such as Claude Desktop)
plan_needed: A Xero organisation in Australia, New Zealand, the UK or the US; a custom connection at $10 a month AUD incl. GST (free on the Demo Company); Node.js 18 or later; some programming experience. Xero stops letting anyone create a new custom connection app or buy a new subscription from 1 December 2026, so steps 1 and 3 only work until 30 November 2026.

steps.do: Set up a custom connection, choose its permissions (scopes), and enter the email address of the Xero user who will authorise it. If it's for your own business, that's you.
steps.see: Xero emails the authorising user.

steps.do: Open Xero's email and follow it to authorise the connection to the organisation.
steps.see: The connection is linked to that one organisation, and you get a client ID and secret.

steps.do: Purchase a custom connection subscription for the organisation.
steps.see: A recurring monthly charge of $10 AUD incl. GST per custom connection.

steps.do: Install Node.js and add the Xero MCP server to your AI app's local configuration. Keep the client ID and secret only in that local file. Never paste them into a chat or a website.
steps.see: The AI app lists the Xero tools after a restart.

steps.do: Test against the Demo Company first, then ask something simple such as a list of overdue invoices.
steps.see: Read tools return data. Create and update tools change real records, so read every request before you approve it.
